notes.title: Slaves will be armed! 0.5.8 version update
notes.notes:
hello everyone! Thank you all for your patronage. This game has sold over 130 sets in three weeks. To thank everyone for their support, we have conducted the first version update to add game content. In version 0.5.8, a brand new card was added to the game and some card values were adjusted. Please refer to the following for detailed updates:

1. Add a new Card - [SERVI ARMATI] (Armed Slave)
This card represents a squad of armed slaves. In emergency situations, slaves can also be armed and sent into battle. They lack experience, equipment, and fighting spirit, but it’s better than having nothing.

This card is a 'unit card', but it has two special skills: It returns to your hand after a victorious battle. The card is not affected by the Chief High Priest and Vestal.

PS: Although the combat power of armed slaves is very weak, their two skills will bring a new change to the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43760747/830fea74d07a88222c4b893333cc2a81e2101b65.png[/img]

2. Card value adjustment. Specifically, it includes:
ELEPHANTI BELLI（War Elephants）: AP and DP reduced from 30 to 25
LEGATUS: AP and DP reduced from 1 to 0
MURI LIGNEI（Wooden Walls）: DP changed from +5 to +6
BUCINATOR（Trumpeter）: AP changed from +5 to +6

3. Improve some minor deficiencies in the UI.

The above is the main update content. If you like this game, we would like to leave your comment on Steam and recommend it to your friends. Finally, we hope everyone has a pleasant time!
